text: EX-99.1 2 patk_specialxmeetingxnrxdr.htm EX-99.1 Document EX-99.1 NEWS RELEASE Patrick Industries Shareholders and LCI Industries Stockholders Overwhelmingly Approve All-Stock Merger ELKHART, IN, November 18, 2026 – Patrick Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ: PATK) (“Patrick”) and LCI Industries (NYSE: LCII) (“LCI” or “Lippert”) today announced that their shareholders and stockholders, respectively, have approved the proposals necessary to complete the companies’ previously announced all-stock merger. “Today marks a significant milestone toward bringing Patrick and Lippert together, and we are grateful for the tremendous support from each company’s shareholders,” said Andy Nemeth, Chief Executive Officer of Patrick. “Our two companies share a deep commitment to our team members, customers and stakeholders, and we believe that together we can deliver more cost-effective, innovative solutions across the Outdoor Enthusiast, Housing and Transportation markets.” “We appreciate the overwhelming support shown at both meetings today, and we are deeply grateful to the team members who work hard every day in service of our customers,” said Johnny Sirpilla, Interim Chief Executive Officer of Lippert. “For decades, Lippert has earned the trust of customers through innovation, reliability and a culture of service, the same values that have contributed to Patrick’s own growth. We are confident that merging the two companies will extend each company’s legacy in a meaningful way, benefiting team members, shareholders, and the community that we are both proud to call home.” At the special meeting of Patrick shareholders held today, at least 97% of the votes cast, representing approximately 93% of all outstanding shares, were voted in favor of the four proposals related to the merger. At the special meeting of LCI stockholders held today, approximately 98% of the votes cast, representing approximately 82% of all outstanding shares, were voted in favor of the necessary proposal related to the merger. The voting results for each special meeting will be reported in Current Reports on Form 8-K to be filed by Patrick and LCI, respectively, with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”). The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027 and remains subject to the receipt of required regulatory approvals and the satisfaction or waiver of other customary closing conditions. Additional information about the transaction is available at patrickandlipperttogether.com . About Patrick Industries, Inc. Patrick (NASDAQ: PATK) is a leading component solutions provider serving original equipment manufacturers and aftermarket customers in the RV, Marine, Powersports and Housing markets. Since 1959, Patrick has empowered manufacturers and outdoor enthusiasts to achieve next-level recreation experiences. Our customer-focused approach brings together design, manufacturing, distribution, and transportation in a full solutions model that defines us as a trusted partner. Patrick is home to more than 85 leading brands, all united by a commitment to quality, customer service, and innovation. Headquartered in Elkhart, IN, Patrick employs approximately 10,000 skilled team members throughout the United States. For more information on Patrick, our brands, and products, please visit www.patrickind.com . About LCI Industries LCI Industries (NYSE: LCII), through its Lippert subsidiary, is a global leader in supplying engineered components to the outdoor recreation and transportation markets. We believe our innovative culture, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and dedication to enhancing the customer experience have established Lippert as a reliable partner for both OEM and aftermarket customers. For more information, visit www.lippert.com .
